facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 学士学位 + 4年以上本科后科研/工程/技术开发经验；首次领导硬科技商业化；全职；可合法在美国工作；英文熟练；非政府融资≤$2M；技术仍在开发、未到全面销售。
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: deep technical expert + leader-ready；技术有 scale 路径、明确 entry market、hard tech for good。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 2年项目。Berkeley/Boston/NY/Houston 有所在地要求；Anywhere 也需参加美国季度线下活动。
facts_raw.International Founder: International only if legally able to work in the US for fellowship duration
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 硬门槛是能够合法在美国工作；需自行满足。项目可提供 relocation stipend 给符合条件者。
facts_raw.Application Materials: 1页 blinded resume、Technical Vision、Technical Reality 等官方材料；按页面限制提交。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 公开 recruitment contact / interest form。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；阶段以 Pre-company–early startup 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目
facts_raw.Notes: Requires deep technical expertise and US work eligibility.

facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Bachelor's degree plus at least four years of research, engineering or technology-development experience. First-time hard-tech commercialization leader; full-time, lawful US work, English proficiency, no more than $2M non-government funding, and technology not yet in full commercial sales.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Deep technical expertise, leadership readiness, a scalable technology, a clear entry market and positive hard-tech impact.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Two years. Berkeley, Boston, New York and Houston tracks have location requirements. The Anywhere track also requires quarterly in-person US events.
facts.International Founder: International only if legally able to work in the US for fellowship duration
facts.Visa / Relocation: Lawful US work authorization is required. Eligible participants may receive a relocation stipend.
facts.Application Materials: A one-page anonymized resume, Technical Vision, Technical Reality and other official materials within the stated limits.
facts.Public Contact Route: Published recruitment contact or interest form.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; primarily at the Pre-company–early startup stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses
facts.Notes: Requires deep technical expertise and US work eligibility.
